Scope.MeasurementScope: All four frozen Game profiles replay the same authoritative entity, recipient, mutation, movement, login/re-entry, and traffic trace. Measurements cover the profile semantic core and a payload-derived synthesized client/proof boundary. Every post-warmup tick is timed in a fresh adapter; trace preparation, semantic oracle verification, diagnostics, and cold snapshots run in a separate evidence replay outside the timer. The secure Network transport is held constant but is not included in the timed core figures.
Scope.SharedTraceContract: Release; 5000 trace ticks; 100 warmup ticks; 4900 measured ticks per profile; designated primary event ticks are reported separately; application proof is immediate after each encoded delivery; public/private/Event/Control traffic counts are identical in every profile row. Payload counters use canonical Game codec sizes and count each semantic delivery once; transport framing/security are excluded.
